what_works: Concept-driven agency shell where the type literally IS the hero — a single overweight grotesk headline spans the viewport on a flat black/white field and video clips swap in behind it on scroll. For a third-generation plumber who wants the name to land, this composition reads as confident, not loud.
what_does_not_translate: The agency's WebGL gallery and video-driven section reveals are out of scope — the typographic hero on a flat bg is the part you copy.
type_observations: Single ultra-bold grotesk (think GT Walsheim Black / Druk Wide) at viewport-filling size; no secondary display family.
